clock.purpose: Countdowns, table codes, receipt numbers only. Never contains Thai glyphs.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, sheets, drawers, toasts, floating cart bar.

components.name: Time rail
components.description: Seating clock: elapsed share of the package with a tick at Last order.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen.
components.html: <button class="btn">รับชำระเงิน</button>

narrative.overview: Everything either helps a person act inside the seating or shows how much of it is left. White ground, hairline cards, ink text, and one orange that does three jobs.
keyCharacteristics: Orange for action, selection and the time rail only
Status as dot plus Thai label
Tabular numerals, Thai outside mono runs

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Orange appears for the primary action, the selected state and the time rail.

rules.name: The Split Run Rule
rules.body: Mono is for numbers that must not be misread; the Thai word beside them stays in Noto Sans Thai.

rules.name: The Border-or-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface has a hairline or a shadow, never both.

dos: Do reserve orange for action, selection and the time rail.
Do pair every status colour with a dot and a Thai label.
donts: Don't use ring or pie charts.
Don't introduce a colour that is not a token.
